review_batches.context: Read all 545 rows and all 518 of following s_02e. Bernst/Sharl stall the party with a smaller Sorge Field. Celica proposes temporary Spirit Mech Core release; Kinari/Ryord/Doris react to losses. Murk arrives with experimental creatures and repeatedly gets Touya's name wrong.
review_batches.decisions: Keep apparent disappearance versus invisibility and Celica's proposal/predictions as attributed. Core release temporarily removes a mech from this battle, not permanent destruction or pilot sacrifice. Gadran's barrier link is fictional notification setup, with no actual exploit/procedure added. Murk's completeness claim is boast, not validated bioscience. Tonma is a deliberate fool/name joke, rendered Twit while preserving Touma/Touta mistakes. Names and all row boundaries retained.

Preserve Derouga's weaker output, Vales's borrowed strength direction, no added crew count/weapon payload, and Baio's hemisphere/underground explanation without claiming every barrier everywhere has that shape.

review_batches.context: Same full reading to 544. Baio's underground explanation and small-field plan, surprise explosion, Bernst/Sharl/Doris engagement, then Sharl's feigned sisterly dying request traps Leone. review_batches.decisions: Do not invent the craft's contents or a bombing procedure. Keep all hidden labels and Baio/Bio/Celea roles. Sharl's reunion/rebirth talk precedes a trap and must not become an unconditional reconciliation. Her programmed-inhibition claim is contradicted by Leone's resolve/action; no real behavioral-control method supplied. Last Bafred plea is support/loyalty without an added explicit relationship or occupant name. Final partial slice is 65 rows.
